content: Pole akevose na mughungi yi: «Djenu duvu mukute wumosi nami, tséwulwanu adingivose mu kékaghule.»
Banowulu yi ebavosili mu mbembu baEberu, bakebwele usigheme. Kaboghu Pole akeghamughe:

«Nyidji muSwife, uburulu o Tarese dji Silisi. Tumbe nyimabanguyile vave Serusaleme, na nyimalongu na Ghamalyele omandonze mughaghe ba tadji betu na tsikiri. Nyimabe na yusile mu dyambu di Nzambi, nane duvu na muni.
Nyimakwane abamadukaange Nzile Fumu teno dufu. Nyimatinde baghetu na babaale o tsughu.

Yivunde yi bavaghulitsi ba paghu na fundu djotsu dji bivunde bi mukute, borungule ughabuse bumbedji yi dingenze nyivosi. Djobeni bamapeghe ne mighande mi musughe muyéveghe baane ba ngudji ba baSwife ba Damase. Nyimawende o musyengi eni mughange badukitsi ba Nzile Fumu abamabe wune, nobabeghe batungu o Serusaleme mu bakilise.
Va mwangulu ave nyangu ebile va djulu muru, nyimabe mu nzile beli na Damase. Suke, yidjalale yineni ayimarambuyile o djulu yimankandile va mbure adji nyimabe.
Nyimaberughe vatsi nowulu dyufi dimavose yi: “Sole, Sole, dibandu yi winkwanini?”
Nyimawivulu yi: “Nde la nyi, Fumu?” Akekwaghule yi: “Menu la Djesu mwise Nasarete, awu wikwani.”
Abamabe nami bamalabe yidjalale, tumbe basamawulu dyufi di djandi omavosaange.
Nyimamuwivulie rye: “Yi nyuvaghe, Fumu?” Fumu amapaghe yi: “Releme, wende o musyengi Damase. Mba vane bowutsingule motsu ame wuvaghe.”
Dibilaange yi yidjalale yeni yimapaghe yidunge, abamabe konge nami, bamankaange mu dikake teno musyengi Damase.
Vane vamabe Nanyase, dibaale dimaghobisaange Nzambi nodedile mughaghe. BaSwife botsu ba Damase bamamughobisaange.
Amayitasene, akebe va mughule ami nopaghe yi: “Sole, mwane ngu ami, bongulile ulabe!” Vane temu eni, ngamwélabe.
Amabwele yi: “Nzambi bakaaghe betu amawusole kale wukedjabe durondu dwandi, na wukelabe djandi o Asungeme nowulu dyufi dyandi.
Mumba wube mbedji andi va wusu batu botsu, mu wanze adi wutsilabe nowulu.
Ka mumba yi wumwékelise? Releme, batusu notandu mabi maghu, nonengile dine dyandi.”»
Pole etubuli nane amatindu ombu mikute misusu
«Nyimaghabughe o Serusaleme, yoyine nyimasambilaange o dulombili du ndaghu Nzambi, ngadile dulasu du Nzambi.
Nyimalabe Fumu omanzingule yi: “Lenge noghusughe Serusaleme, mumba abetsani wune baghosinge bumbedji bwaghu mu menu.”
Menu nyimawake yi: “Fumu, bédjabi yi nyimawendaange mu mandaghu motsu ma tsambu ma baSwife, mu dimbise bango yitu mu ndedju, nobatinde o tsughu.
Mba ave malungu ma mbedji awu Yityene mamadekila, me wa nyimabe vane. Nyimasingisile abamamubokaange, nyimakele ne bidwaru bi abamamuboke.”
Fumu amanzingule yi: “Wende, mumba nyuwutinde vale, ombu mikute misusu!”»
Yivunde yi baghore ewivuli Pole byuvu
Mughungi wuke wulu Pole tena posulu djusite. Mba botsu bakeghamughe: «Tutsyemusyanu mutu eni wughu! Afu! Asawelemine utsane va butambe bwébubu!»
Bamaghamughaange, bakevulaange bikutu byowu, mba baketindaange difufundu na djulu.
Yivunde yi baghore akeveghe dirume dyukotise Pole o ndaghu baghore nomudimbe mikase, mumba akevose mu udjabe dibandu yi mughungi wimughamuyili.
Tumbe ave bamamutungile mu umudimbe, Pole akewivule yivunde ayimabe vane yi: «Dune musughe wu udimbe mwise Rome mikase, awughaa ne wufundusu?»
Na ewulu nane, yivunde yi baghore akelubuse yivunde yandi: «Akemuvaghe yi tsyé wuvale? Dibaale dyédidi mwise Rome!»
Yivunde yi baghore akeyilabe Pole nomuwivule yi: «Nzinguli, ngenze wudji mwise Rome?» Pole akewaghule yi: «Yine.»
Yivunde yi baghore akewake yi: «Nyimaveghe mbongu tsipwele mu udile musughe wunengulu “mwise Rome”.» Tumbe Pole akevose yi: «Menu mwise Rome mu duburulu dwami.»
Suke, abe mbé baronde umudimbe mu umuvosise, bakekakene nandi. Djabeni yivunde yi baghore akebe na ghome, ave amadjabile yi amatungise mwise Rome na bapange.
Pole va wusu fundu banzonzi

Yivunde yi baghore amabe na nzale udjabe tsikiri adibamafwengilile Pole. Ladibandu, va kedi amamunyangulile nonengile bivunde bi bavaghulitsi ba paghu na fundu djotsu dji banzonzi ba baSwife. Mba akebeghe Pole va wusu owu.
